'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Ian W. DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ian W.]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Established As The Bunker]]
* '''Username:''' GhostTrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
